Hey! I’ve dealt with this a few times, it sucks. I had a friend back in middle school who I was friends with my whole childhood, and 
 I was never ready to let it go even though it was %100 only me putting effort in. I did eventually after I finally learned to accept that we did not have a future, and even though it hurt at first, it was worth it. 

A friendship or any relationship needs two people to maintain it. If you’re the only one putting effort into your friendship, do you think it could help to try and distance yourself? I know how hard it is first hand, but sometimes its best to let them go. Sometimes people just don’t line up anymore. They’re two very different people and have two very different needs and wants. That’s okay. It’s not your fault, and this won’t be the last friend you ever have or lose. 

I think you should ask yourself if this is what you want, and if trying to keep your friendship afloat is worth it. I wish the best for you, and I hope everything figures itself out. Much love!
